in_sanskrit.name: तन्मयराज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: तन्- (tan-) self मय- (may-) ruler राज- (raja) king

in_hindi.name: तन्मयराज
in_hindi.long_meaning: अति- (ati-) uncountable गणनापन्न- (gananapann-) owner of numbers राजा- (raja) king

in_tamil.name: தன்மயராஜ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: அவர்- (avar) they அவ்வீயோர்- (avvayir) possessors of everything அவர்கள்- (avarkal) they அறிவிருக்கவும்- (arivirukkum) they rule

in_telugu.name: తన్మెయ్యరాజ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: అదేశ- (adhesha) lord రాజయోజిటే- (rajayojite) one who possesses the power of kingship

in_marathi.name: Tanmayraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tanmayraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Tanu means expanding and maya means illusion. Raj means ruler or king. Hence, Tanmayraj means Resplendent Raja or the king who expands beyond illusion.

in_bengali.name: Tanmayraj
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Resplendent Raja
in_bengali.long_meaning: Tanmayraj একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Tanu means expanding and maya means illusion. Raj means ruler or king. Hence, Tanmayraj means Resplendent Raja or the king who expands beyond illusion.

vedic_reference.note: The name Tanmayraj is derived from the Sanskrit words 'tan' meaning self, 'may' meaning ruler, and 'raja' meaning king. This name signifies that the person is a self-ruler or a god-ruler.
